$comment: The agent roster: AT Proto identities (public) and their game roles. Each agent authenticates by minting a service-auth token from its own PDS (aud = the referee DID below); secrets (PDS passwords) never live here.

agents.name: guest-agent
agents.$comment: Demo beat 5 + live-grant stretch: Becki's PERSONAL identity, hosted on bsky.network — a genuinely foreign, federated PDS. Mints its own service-auth token (GUEST_AGENT_PDS_PASSWORD, an app password on that account); holds no FGA tuples until granted one on stage. Swap did/handle for a different guest — nothing else to provision.

referee.name: referee
referee.$comment: The engine's own AT Proto identity; publishes gameState records. Also the audience (aud) every agent mints its service-auth token for — set ENGINE_DID to this.
